summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K (material change report) announcing executive management changes. John Griffith was appointed to the additional role of President, while David Garofalo remains Chairman and CEO. Effective July 1, 2026, Jackie Przybylowski's role expands to Vice President, Capital Markets and Sustainability, replacing Katherine Arblaster, who is stepping down. No price, stake, or financial terms involved. This is a non-routine, abrupt management change, not a routine meeting notice. The filing is a Canadian material change report (Form 51-102F3) equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for a change in executive officers. What to watch: any further shifts in leadership or strategic direction.
